comparison.objective: Sort six good biscuit packs from a moving belt into cases while rejecting two cracked packs.
comparison.physical_skill: Fast bimanual perception, selection, and repeated pick-and-place from a moving conveyor.
comparison.success_condition: Six good packs occupy case cells before the red line while cracked packs pass; the record supplies no finer numeric scoring rubric.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is throughput-limited dynamic sorting, with no precision tooling, impact fracture, or small-fragment recovery.
